rules.title: H.5222 – An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market
rules.requirement: Proposed Massachusetts bill that would limit the use of algorithms to fix or coordinate rents. It is not law. As of the retrieval date it sat in the House Committee on Ways and Means.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental housing market in Massachusetts. The bill text is not in this document, so its scope is unknown.
rules.quoted_span: An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market
rules.conflict_note: Status is uncertain. The page lists the 194th session as current and shows H.5222 referred to House Ways and Means on 3/12/2026, with no later action. Formal sessions of the 194th General Court usually end July 31, 2026, so the bill is likely stalled, though it technically stays alive until the session ends in early January 2027. Check again after the session closes and mark it failed if it was not enacted.
